summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader, _ProgressContext, _file_progress helper; module-level open and wrap_file; Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file with overloads), tests/test_progress.py (16 new tests before the script-entry block), docs/source/progress.rst (two subsections under Advanced usage), CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased/Added bullet linking PR 1759). Nothing was run: tests, mypy, and black were not executed, so verification is by reading only. Nothing was committed. Design notes: module-level open uses cast(Any, mode) when calling progress.open to avoid a str overload; no suppressions were added to the module-level functions; io.open is used inside progress.py because the module-level open shadows the builtin. Exiting the reader closes it only when it owns the handle, per spec.
